title: Best Suitcase (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were identified from the provided sources, prioritizing items mentioned by more than one source. The Away Bigger Carry‑On with Pocket was the only product explicitly named in the excerpts.
assumptions: No price information was available in the sources, so price fields are null.

verdict.line: Picture a traveler who needs a roomy, smart suitcase that can charge devices on the go. The Away Bigger Carry‑On with Pocket offers a removable battery and plenty of space, making it ideal for short trips and frequent flyers. Its main catch is that the battery is removable, which may be inconvenient for some users.
